AL.name: John Hubbard, tow truck driver
AL.line: An Alabama tow truck driver who died in 2016 while working at an accident site on Interstate 20/59 in Tuscaloosa.

CO.name: Trooper Cody J. Donahue, Colorado State Patrol
CO.line: A Colorado State Patrol trooper struck and killed by a semi in November 2016 while investigating a crash on the shoulder of Interstate 25 in Douglas County.

GA.name: Spencer Pass, Georgia DOT HERO operator
GA.line: A Georgia DOT highway emergency response operator struck and killed on January 31, 2011 while helping a stranded driver on I-85 near Metropolitan Parkway.

IL.name: Lieutenant Scott Gillen, Chicago Fire Department
IL.line: A Chicago firefighter struck and killed by an intoxicated driver on December 23, 2000 while helping at a crash on the Dan Ryan Expressway.

MN.name: Corporal Ted Foss, Minnesota State Patrol
MN.line: A Minnesota State Patrol trooper struck and killed by a passing vehicle on August 31, 2000 during a traffic stop on Interstate 90.

NH.name: Staff Sergeant Jesse Sherrill, New Hampshire State Police
NH.line: A New Hampshire state trooper killed on October 28, 2021 when a tractor-trailer hit his cruiser during a highway work detail in Portsmouth.

NY.name: Trooper Robert W. Ambrose and Deputy Sheriff Glenn M. Searles
NY.line: A State Trooper killed in 2002 on the Thruway in Yonkers when a speeding driver hit his patrol car, and an Onondaga County deputy killed in 2003 while helping a motorist.
